C0274.title: Beijing Chaoyang Police Bust Internet Company Using Crawlers to Steal Livestream Data, 23 Detained
C0274.summary: In October 2021, Chaoyang police cracked a case of illegally obtaining computer information system data. A sudden surge in traffic was detected in a shopping website's livestream rooms. Investigation revealed that a criminal gang led by Wang Yiyi, Yang Yuning, and Yang used crawler software to illegally steal livestream data and sold it online at high prices for profit.
